prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-21830
prose.body:
Hello Driftmoor Retail Team,

I hope you are having a productive week! This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-21830 for the recent analytics services provided by Stanmere Analytics. The total amount due is 5020.77 USDC.

We noticed this invoice is currently pending. To keep our partnership running smoothly and to help us process the payment promptly, please send the funds to our standard vendor wallet:

0xf53618778631d766f084f8de01852786d741d55f

This is the same address we have used for previous transactions with your team. Once sent, our automated systems will verify the receipt within a few minutes and update your account status accordingly.

If you have already sent the payment, please disregard this note. If you have any questions about the line items or the invoice itself, feel free to reply to this email or give us a call. We appreciate your continued trust in Stanmere Analytics.

Best regards,

The Stanmere Analytics Billing Team
